instruction: Play any song released in 2022 from my Spotify song library.
notes: Single-app task (spotify). The world facts (in-library, released-in, target-year) are static in :init; the agent only learns which library song was released in 2022 by listing the library (spotify-show-song-library carries the discovered song/year as extra non-API parameters and asserts found-target-song). play_music with that song_id updates the MusicPlayer to playing state, which is the only database change the evaluation expects. Pagination of show_song_library (page_index) is a runtime detail not modeled; the reference solution may call it several times. complete_task takes no answer since the instruction is not a question.
